items.text: Patient reports a multi-systemic onset of fatigue, joint pain, and photosensitive skin rashes.
Family history is positive for lupus (mother).
day 15-19: Onset of severe fatigue and morning stiffness in knees and finger joints.
day 22-30: Appearance of butterfly-shaped facial rash after sun exposure, recurrent oral ulcers, and Raynaud phenomenon in cold.
day 37-48: Reports of hair loss in clumps and an episode of sharp pleuritic chest pain.
day 51-55: Low-grade fever, swollen wrists, and lab findings of proteinuria and leukopenia.
day 59-85: Recurrence of oral ulcers, ankle edema, photosensitive rash, and persistent fatigue/alopecia.
Clinical presentation resembles Systemic lupus erythematosus.
Could you describe the frequency and triggers of the facial rash?
Are you experiencing any other symptoms when the chest pain occurs, such as shortness of breath?
Paziente riferisce astenia, dolori articolari migranti, eruzioni cutanee fotosensibili e anomalie ematologiche/urinarie.
Riferita familiarità per lupus (madre).
day 15-19: Insorgenza di Fatigue e Joint stiffness mattutina a ginocchia e dita.
day 22-30: Comparsa di Malar rash dopo esposizione solare, Oral ulcer ricorrenti e Raynaud phenomenon da freddo.
day 37-51: Riferita Alopecia, Pleuritic chest pain, febbre (37,9) e Joint swelling ai polsi.
day 55: Esami evidenziano Proteinuria e Leukopenia.
day 59-85: Persistenza di Oral ulcer, Joint swelling (caviglie, polsi) e recidive di Malar rash e Raynaud phenomenon.
Il quadro clinicosembles Systemic lupus erythematosus.
Può descrivere meglio la natura del dolore toracico avvertito al day 48?
Ha notato altri sintomi cutanei o mucosali oltre al rossore facciale e alle ulcere orali?
